clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, hunters bring Plainstrider Beaks back to the Crossroads. Huntmasters use them as proof that birds threatening local provisions have been culled.

Plainstriders forage around the Crossroads and threaten its supplies. Greater, fleeting, and ornery plainstriders roam the surrounding savannah. Sergra Darkthorn asks arriving hunters to bring back their beaks as proof that the flocks have been culled away from supply lines and storehouses.
